Loaded with aggressive styling (including eye-grabbing black hardware), the RG550 is a fast-playing, hard-rocking tone machine.

listings.description:
Free shipping and no tax (to most states, outside of IL) on our website!

The Return of an Icon: Ibanez Genesis Collection RG550

When Ibanez launched the RG550 in 1987, it redefined what a high-performance electric guitar could be. Built for lightning-fast playability, ultimate tonal flexibility, and unyielding stage presence, the original RG became the benchmark for shredders and modern rock guitarists worldwide.

The Ibanez Genesis Collection RG550 revives that classic late-â€™80s legacy, handcrafting those iconic specs in Japan with modern precision and relentless quality.

Key Features & Built-for-Speed Performance

  • Super Wizard 5-Piece Neck: Experience effortless speed across all 24 jumbo frets. Crafted from maple and walnut, the ultra-thin Super Wizard neck profile delivers rigid stability with seamless playability for sweeping arpeggios and intricate solos.
  • Edge Tremolo System: The legendary Ibanez Edge double-locking tremolo returns to deliver rock-solid tuning stability, precise intonation, and effortless return-to-pitchâ€”no matter how aggressive your dive-bombs or subtle your vibrato.
  • Versatile V7 / S1 / V8 Pickup Configuration: Outfitted with an HSH pickup layout, the RG550 offers incredible tonal range:
    • V7 Neck Humbocker: Tight and punchy, perfect for articulate riffing and soaring lead lines.
    • S1 Middle Single-Coil: Delivers crisp, bright single-coil clarity for clean passages and biting rhythm work.
    • V8 Bridge Humbocker: Warm yet aggressive with balanced mid-range response, ideal for heavy high-gain crunch.
  • Classic Basswood Body: Well-balanced and lightweight, the basswood body produces a clear, even tonal footprint that lets your pickups bite through any mix.
  • Unmistakable Japanese Craftsmanship: Hand-built in Japan as part of the Genesis Collection, every detail pays homage to the golden era of high-performance rock guitars.

listings.title: Ibanez RG550 Genesis Desert Sun Yellow
listings.description:
The Ibanez RG550 Genesis Electric Guitar brings back vibe of the good old days with precise construction by Japanese craftsmanship, to prove that this iconic guitar has always led the rock guitar scene.

Ibanez builds guitars for all levels of players -- from beginners to the most demanding masters of the instrument. Regardless of price, Ibanez always strives to offer the absolute best sound, style, and playability in its class.

It all started in 1987, the debut of the Ibanez RG was a milestone in rock guitar history. With its spartan look, supreme playability and versatility due to innovative specs, the RG made a big impact and is still evolving today.

A prominent feature of the original RG is the ultra thin Super Wizard neck, constructed of five solid pieces of Maple & Walnut for absolute rock solid stability to provide extra-smooth playing.

With the classic Edge tremolo bridge, the most extreme sonic acrobatics can be fearlessly performed with confidence that the guitar will effortlessly return to perfect tuning.

The original Ibanez V7, S1, V8 pickups offer a wide range of sound and attack when combined with the 5-way pickup switch.

Additionally, incredible tuning stability is achieved through the use of the Gotoh machine heads.

Product Features

  • Super Wizard 5pc Maple/Walnut neck
  • Basswood body
  • Maple fretboard w/Black dot inlay
  • Jumbo frets
  • Edge tremolo bridge
  • V7 (H) neck pickup (Passive/Ceramic)
  • S1 (S) middle pickup (Passive/Alnico)
  • V8 (H) bridge pickup (Passive/Alnico)
  • Scale Length: 648mm/25.5in
  • Nut Width: 43mm

Personal Thoughts:
The late-'80s RG550 is one of the great Japanese superstrats and still one of the coolest production Ibanez guitars from the era. It has everything people want from a proper early RG: basswood body, original Wizard neck, Edge trem, HSH layout and that unmistakable stripped-back late-'80s look. Road Flare is a brilliant colour on these too, and one of the finishes that immediately makes the guitar feel period-correct and full of character. The original V1 / S1 / V2 pickup set also suits these guitars really well, keeping them versatile and aggressive in exactly the way an old RG should be. A very cool MIJ RG and one of the benchmark models from the golden era of Ibanez shred guitars.

Condition Report:
Good condition. There is some minor paint missing to both horns, two small neck cracks, some binding marks and general small impressions throughout. Overall it remains functionally sound and still presents as an honest vintage player from this period.

Part Exchange Welcome:
Part exchange welcome, video demos are available via our YouTube channel at Squealing Pig Guitars, personal consignment service available via our site at 10% rate.

A prominent feature of the original RG is the ultra-thin Super Wizard neck— constructed of five solid pieces of Maple & Walnut for absolute rock solid stability to provide extra-smooth playing. With the classic Edge tremolo bridge, the most extreme sonic acrobatics can be fearlessly performed with confidence that the guitar will effortlessly return to perfect tuning. The original Ibanez V7, S1, V8 pickups offer a wide range of sound and attack when combined with the 5-way pickup switch. Additionally, incredible tuning stability is achieved through the use of the Gotoh machine heads.

Features

  • Neck Type : Super Wizard 5pc Maple/Walnut neck
  • Body : Basswood body
  • Fretboard : Maple fretboard w/Black dot inlay
  • Fret : 24 Jumbo frets
  • Bridge : Edge tremolo bridge
  • Neck Pickup : V7 (H) neck pickup (Passive/Ceramic)
  • Middle Pickup : S1 (S) middle pickup (Passive/Alnico)
  • Bridge Pickup : V8 (H) bridge pickup (Passive/Alnico)
  • Hardware Color : Black

Neck Dimensions

  • Width at Last Fret : 2.2" / 58.0mm
  • Width at Nut : 1.7" / 43.0mm
  • Thickness at 12th : 0.7" / 19.0mm
  • Thickness at 1st : 0.7" / 17.0mm
  • Radius : 15.8" / 430.0mm
